question: Estimate the adoption of online therapy / mental health services in urban India post-2024.
idealClarificationQuestions: Online video / chat therapy via apps (YourDost, MindPeers, Amaha, Wysa)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: urban population → mental-health-aware subset → online vs offline split → app adoption.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mental health aware / open to therapy: ~15% = 24M (rising post-COVID, but stigma still present).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, used online/app-based therapy: ~30% = 1.8M (rest prefer offline psychiatrists).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1.5-2M urban Indians use online therapy/mental health apps monthly.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Mental health aware / open to therapy
Of these, considered/tried any kind of therapy
Active monthly users on therapy apps

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~1.5-2M urban Indians use online therapy/mental health apps monthly.

calculationFlow: Mental health aware / open to therapy: ~15% = 24M (rising post-COVID, but stigma still present).
Of these, considered/tried any kind of therapy: ~25% = 6M.
Of these, used online/app-based therapy: ~30% = 1.8M (rest prefer offline psychiatrists).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~1.5-2M urban Indians use online therapy/mental health apps monthly.
